speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are at my table. Titus is at the Cross Keys. I can hear none of it, which is what a wall is for.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not in it today. The desk has me.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf is the same loaf. A finger short of the notch. I did not buy another.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. The letter is still upstairs. Tomorrow, and not by your going.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Threepence, whether you make a speech of it or not. Do not send me to Carter Lane to be useful. Hobbins keeps his own hour, and it is not this one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not send you. I have a page already struck. I am not going out to mend it in a yard.
